speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) whether the Ministry can provide details of its internal investigation that was conducted in relation to the irregularities discovered in PUB contracts; and (b) what are the interim measures being taken to strengthen the governance process.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In addition, I will address two written PQs filed by Mr Foo Cexiang and Mr Shawn Loh for the 22 and 25 September 2025 Sittings, respectively.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: These five PQs relate to the Public Utilities Board's (PUB's) lapses highlighted in the recent Auditor-General's Office (AGO) report.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: I will respond to these questions together so that I can give a comprehensive reply.

speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: If the Members are satisfied with the reply given, they may wish to withdraw their PQs.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: My Ministry takes the AGO findings seriously and has conducted comprehensive internal investigations into the contract management lapses contained in the report.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: It has also conducted a thorough review of similar contracts and did not find such irregularities.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: It will follow up with its own disciplinary actions should the Police investigations uncover any wrongdoing.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: The Certificates of Analysis (COAs) were altered to include required information which has been omitted.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: The alterations were done to cover up the incompleteness of the original documents to be provided to the AGO auditors, but the contents were factual.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: It has issued a formal reprimand to the officer and will be downgrading the officer's performance grade.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: On the AGO findings on the lack of comprehensive coverage of maintenance contracts for PUB's water quality analysers at private sector plants, it was already working on addressing the gap before the AGO audit.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: It has since addressed the issue by using its other contracts to cover the scope of work.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: It installed water quality analysers as additional precautionary checks over and above the analysers installed by the private sector operators, the results of the analysers cross-checked daily with water sampling tests.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: PUB has taken the following steps to strengthen its processes.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: First, it has increased the scope of its internal audits on procurement and contract management.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: This includes additional checks on star rates in contract variations and use of digital tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to improve checks on contractual requirements and detect fraud.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: Second, PUB has tightened the standard operating procedures (SOPs) for contract management, to ensure alignment with contractual requirements, such as requiring the submission of the original COAs.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: PUB has also tightened its SOPs for checks on the quality of the stocks used in its operations.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: It has confirmed that the quality of the stocks that it has received earlier met its requirements.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: It will take appropriate action against contractors who fail to meet their obligations, including those who submit non-compliant COAs.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: Where feasible, it is automating processes to reduce reliance on manual monitoring and the risk of human error.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: The first is, I note that there were several individual officers involved.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Other than the disciplinary action taken against these individual officers, will the Ministry also consider moving upstream to conduct, for example, refresher training across the board, as well as employing a digital automated or AI means upstream, beyond just on the audit.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: The second supplementary question I have is whether any of this impact the speed and projects that are under these contracts.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: Speaker, the short answer to the first question is no.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: One is whether there will be training involved on other officers, including those that are more senior.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: The answer is yes, and will there be automation, yes.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: As I have mentioned in my reply, we will look at where technology is helpful, to help staff manage the contract requirements.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: And as to the speed of implementation, that is definitely not something that we want to compromise on.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: This audit and this report have given PUB many good lessons and we would like to implement and run a tighter ship without affecting the effectiveness of the agency.

speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong Central)
text: I wish to state that PUB, as our national water agency, has a critical mission of ensuring Singapore's water security.

speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong Central)
text: I think it is also important to state for the record that, in my view, PUB has excelled in this mission by boldly innovating.

speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong Central)
text: So, my question really is in the wake of the AGO's findings and PUB's response to tighten processes.

speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong Central)
text: How will PUB also ensure that it preserves and indeed, continues to grow this spirit of innovation, of boldness, of mission focus?

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: In fact, this report has told us that innovation can be undertaken in areas, such as operations, in procurement.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: And I think with more application of appropriate technology, our officers can be more effective and therefore, relieve themselves from the mundane work so that they can focus on more strategic and more important functions.

speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
text: As we understand it, the number of contracts that each officer does have to deal with could be very copious, so I would like to check the Minister's response.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: Indeed, thank you very much to the Member for his questions and the care and concern for officers in PUB.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: In any case, if there are crunches in terms of resources, I have been told that officers are able to raise these issues with their supervisors.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: But more importantly, I go back to my point.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: I think there are technologies that can help us to make our operations a lot more automated and also less prone to human errors.

speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
text: There were two types of errors here that were discovered by the AGO.

speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
text: So, my question to the Minister is whether in the reprimand framework of PUB, is there a difference between the two?

speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
text: Because in her reply, both officers were reprimanded.

speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
text: And if there is a difference, do we then treat a lack of integrity with more seriousness?

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: I think that it may not be clear as to in which of the findings was there a lack of integrity.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: I think there is one that is being mentioned in the report about accuracy in the rates that is being used in the variation order – that is being investigated.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: We have been holding our assessment at this point in time, pending the outcome of the investigation.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: A staff had basically altered a document, in order to provide completeness of information on that document.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: We have found that the facts were not misrepresented.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: The documents were factual, so there was an error of judgement on the staff's part to use alteration as a way of providing the information that is required by AGO.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: Having said that, PUB will always review the contractors from time to time, looking at its ability to supply and support the operations of the agencies.
